reviews.title: The crew politeness/ service made up for the plane inadequcies
reviews.text: I often take Asian airlines like (MAS, SIA, Thai) and I will compare XiamenAir against them. What I like 1. The crew uniform is kinda neat and smart. The blue color looks good on them. 2. The food. Among all the airlines, I always enjoy XIamen Airline‘s local xiamen food. For this flight, they served pork minced rice with other things, which I really enjoyed. The taste was good. 3. Polite and efficient crew. Despite the full flight with chinese passengers, the efficient and polite to all incessant request for pillows, blanket and drinks. 4. The fight announcement was made in english, mandarin and the local fujianese (min an) dialect. I am a fujianese, so hearing the announcent in my mother tongue gives me very good vibes. What I din like 1. No inseat charging port. For a 4hr flight, I would expect a charging port to be available 2. No inseat entertaiment, only an overhead unit which shows a boring movie. I would expect Xiamen Airline to provide inflight wifi streaming to personal devices capability. The overhead unit is so ancient. 3. No wifi to be purchased. Overall, the food matters to me more, so I wld rate。this flight Xiamen Air as 7/10.

Xiamen Air does not reply to any queries from Expedia.

reviews.text: i was sepose to fly 17 April 2023 00.40 with Xiamen Airlines to Amsterdam. I was at the check-in desk 16 April 20.00 . in my wheelchair. they told me I can t check in. why I asked? no reaction. I got no respons. my pasport was not expired, I got my PCR test. all y papers in order. they just refused me. and left me at the airport all alone. no help to get me on another flyte, no hotel , no drink ore food coupon. nothing. they left me, a person in wheelchair, with 3 suites case all alone on the airport. all alone. finally I found a person who drove me to taxies, and I drove the rest of the night to find a hotel that would take me in . I booked a new flight, other airline ofcourse 1,5 x the price. . but now I don t get my money back, all the cost I had , the emotional damage , the cost you have a person in a wheelchair... nothing. this is just criminal.
reviews.author: me y

reviews.title: Uncomfortable Planes, Bad Food, Terrible Transfer at Xiamen Airport
reviews.text: First, they put us on a tiny 737 for the six-hour flight from Bali to Xiamen. No in-flight entertainment, not even so much as a pair of headphones, and nowhere to charge your phone, which is a challenge because you require your phone to do the online customs declaration. Then, in six hours, all they served us was a piece of sweet bread, a tiny bag of chips, and 100mL of sweet yoghurt drink. This is the least space I've ever had on a plane. There was so little room, it was difficult even to put a bag on the floor. There were only 30cm between my seat and the one in front of me. Very uncomfortable and no room to move at all. Then, we get to Xiamen airport and find out our connecting flight is leaving two hours later than scheduled, so a three-hour layover became a five-hour one. Transferring at Xiamen airport is a hot mess. You need to go through immigration, exit the secure area, check in again from the outside, and go through security a second time, even if you're not even stopping in China. At immigration, they stopped most of the foreigners and questioned them intensely before letting them through. My husband was questioned for over an hour before we could go on to our connecting flight. He's lived in China for 12 years; they already have all of his information on file, but they questioned him anyway, sometimes asking the same question three or four times. Not sure if it was incompetence, lack of training, some new system, or a mandate to heighten security, but either way, it was not okay. Another family connecting from our flight was also stopped for over an hour. The husband got through, but they held the wife and their baby at the immigration desk for an hour and a quarter. They were literally going from Bali to Seoul and had nothing to do with China, but they stopped them and questioned them, collected all ten finger prints from each of them, made them submit to facial recognition photos, etc. It was a total abuse of privacy. Avoid Xiamen airport and Xiamen Airlines if you have any choice at all.
reviews.author: Dee L

reviews.title: Excellent Customers
reviews.text: While flying from Vancouver to Vietnam I had a 10 hour layover in Xiamen airport in China before a connecting trip to Vietnam. When I was going to board my connecting flight to Vietnam I realized I had not purchased a travel visa. I was in a panic situation because I only had 24 hours before I could leave China Legally and I couldn't board my flight. The firewalls made it difficult to have a consistent internet connection and purchase a visa ticket on my phone. Fortunately Xiamen was able to reschedule my flight the next evening free of charge and also booked me a hotel in the city to spend the night so I didn't have to sleep in the airport!!! I was able to process a visa within the right time frame that would allow me into Vietnam and avoid any further problems. Thank Xiamen Airlines for your professional and reliable service!

reviews.title: I am satisfied with everything except the food on board
reviews.text: 個人的には、中国系航空会社の中では最も良い印象を受けた。チェックイン時及び、搭乗時対応、更には、機内の清掃も行き届いており、CAの対応も良い印象、なので自然と乗客のマナーも良くなる感じを受けた。ただ、惜しむらくは、機内食ですね これならば、寧ろ無くすか、或いは有料化して充実度を向上させる位割り切れば、もっと良いかなと思った。
reviews.author: 365GT4-BB

reviews.title: Flyers Beware!
reviews.text: This has been, by far, the worst airline that I have ever had the misfortune to encounter. They have shown such poor customer service that I was compelled to review them on multiple platforms to warn other potential customers of their airline. I showed up at Xiamen Airport (Xiamen Airlines flagship hub) 5 hours in advance of my flight for two reasons. First, I knew that my bags would be overweight (I was moving back home to the states), and I wanted to see by how much. I had some items I could discard to make the baggage lighter, but I wanted to see how much over I was. Second, since COVID still had regulations, I wanted to be sure that I had enough time to get through the process on time. Xiamen Airlines, unfortunately, did not make any of this process possible. When I arrived at the airport, I was informed that I would not be able to set foot into the international wing until two hours before the flight took off. This forced me to wait patiently at a fast-food restaurant until they opened the wing. Once the wing was open, the sold-out flight loaded up the kiosks. The line was moving unbelievably slow, but I knew that the attendants were able to see me waiting (I am the only Black person on the flight, and I am also 6’4”, which will be important for later) and that I probably will need extra help. This entire process of getting through the line nearly took an hour and a half. Once I got to the front of the line, the first thing that they informed me of was that there were only middle seats left. I said to them that they saw me waiting in line, and I am considerably taller than most of the people on the flight. Rather than give any explanation, the only thing they said was, “we know”. Checking my watch, I knew that there was no time to belabor the point any longer. I had three bags, and I knew that they would have weight problems. In addition, I would need to pay extra for the third bag. I was ready to pay for the extra bag, but what happened next was madness. They told me that my bags were overweight. I informed them that I knew it would be and that I would take out items and pack them in my empty carry-ons to make the weight acceptable. They said they understood that, but they then took my bags, tagged them, and sent them to the back. They then charged me for the bags that I did not get a chance to empty. I informed them that I was supposed to have an opportunity to empty my bags to make weight and they informed me that I was late, so it was my fault. This was the point that I told them I had been there for five hours while they were there for two. They seemed not to care. They only wanted me to pay for my bags and move on. I told them I would take it up with customer service later, and they didn’t seem to care. The reason for this is because getting a hold of customer service is a NIGHTMARE. I sent them countless emails explain my grievances with the airline, and it took them literal DAYS (and one time a week) to respond to me. The fact that this could not be resolved in a matter of minutes was frustrating enough, but then for them to not care about my original complaint and say that it was my fault is what drove me to write this complaint today. It took them a grand total of 3.5 WEEKS to even come to a resolution! They seem not only to have no pride in their services but also care for their customers. I have flown various airlines, domestically and internationally. I have also seen my fair share of I have never had such an awful experience that would make me write a negative review of an airline. From the beginning to the end of this issue, this airline has not shown an ounce of decent customer service. If you have the extra money to spend on a superior airline, do it or be prepared to share a story such as this! FLYERS BEWARE!!!!!

reviews.title: Extremely old airplane and limited service
reviews.text: Plane is around 38 years old. Old uncomfortable seats. Adjusting only 1,2 cm backwards. See last photo for maximum adjustment. Food only one dish available from a range of 4 main dishes. Drinks only water. Bit too less choice for business class. Positive: Boarding starts on time. Security concept of Pudong airport for Covid19. Negative: Flight departures with a delay and without any information. To sit on those polyester chairs longer than needed is indeed painful. No video entertainment. Check in from Xiamen Air was badly organized. Only one 1 account for business class. Waiting time 22 minutes. Lounge in the new Pudong terminal is ok. Summary: Not happy but healthy l. There are other Chinese Airlines which are not perfect but much better organized. Xiamen Air is on the same level as horrible spring airlines company.

The plane boarded early and left bang on time ( somewhat of a miracle in China) The food was especially wierd, a bit like a savoury chicken jelly served alongside a sweet bread roll stuffed with egg yolk. Unusually for Chinese airlines, beer was available. The in flight movie was switched off before the end (40 mins from landing) but otherwise the flight was fine. So so so much better than China Eastern.

reviews.title: XiaMen Airline sells fraud flight tickets and refused to refund the passenger! Shocking!!!
reviews.text: XiaMen Airline sells fraud flight tickets and refused to refund the passenger! Shocking!!! Chinese Embassy in the Netherlands announced that no transfer passengers would be allowed to enter the Netherlands for the connecting flight to China from 18th November. XiaMen Airline is aware of this new policy. However, they continue advertising and selling the connecting flight tickets through the Netherlands! I bought the ticket from London to China via the transfer in Amsterdam. However, when I started to go through the travel detailed soon after I bought the ticket, I was shocked to find out that this is an impossible flight route due to the reason above. I contacted XiaMen Airline immediately. I received a reply call informing me that my request for refunding my flight ticket is rejected. The reason given was that XiaMen Airline made a policy, they only refund the flight tickets which were bought before 31st October 2020, and the flight will take off after 31st October 2020. My flight ticket was bought yesterday, 9th December 2020. Therefore, I fell out of the category of refunding. I pointed out that if they knew this is the policy, why they were still selling the tickets from London to China, which needs to transfer at Amsterdam. I was told that it was because some passengers will take the flights from Amsterdam. This was not answering to my question. However, the customer service only gave me “standard answers” in a circle. I would like to get your advice, what should I do now to get the refund of my flight ticket! More than my cased, how could XiaMen Airline sell the flight ticket, which is impossible for any passenger to board at Amsterdam? I am beyond angry!!! I would advise all, try all means to avoid buying flight tickets from XiaMen airline! Min

This is my 23rd flight so far, and this is the least enjoyable and comfortable that I ever had.

reviews.title: Worst experience and biggest regret buying xiamen airlines ticket
reviews.text: Thank you xiamen airlines for ruined my new year holiday. Don't get tricked by its cheap price, since they had such a horrible services. This is my sad story with xiamen airlines. I am Indonesian passport holder, but currently living in Singapore and will travel to Seoul for vacation. As always I do my research before the trip, and carefully pick the best yet affordable flight ticket. I picked SQ as my first flight going to Seoul. And then for my return, I was considering about xiamen airlines. Its cheap, but said we do have to transit in xiamen. Then after some times, okay our decision went for xiamen airlines. Later after we booked the flight, I checked that xiamen Airport didn't have a waiting area for transit and International passengers. So we have to proceed the immigration when transit. I was started to panic and did another deeply research about a visa. Did I need a visa just for less than 2 hours transit in xiamen? I asked the Chinese embassy, and they said, they didn't know, said to ask the airline. Then I ask the xiamen airlines, and they provided me the same answer as the embassy. Feeling desperately helpless and our duedate is getting closer, I found a websites that says China has 72 and 24hours free visa for transit tourist. Well it has been categorised based on depends countries, and Indonesia was included on the list for 24 hours free visa exemption. Also I found a blog saying the same experience as me, which is Indonesian travelled with xiamen and have a transit in xiamen. They was stopped at the immigration, but after shown some legal documents and flight ticket, they was available to proceed to the next flight. So what I did was the same. I get all mh documents ready and welll printed. And here's my case. At the day of my xiamen flight, the check in staff at the counter was rejected me as I have no visa. And I said my explanation and shown all my documents. Apparently they still didn't let me check in. And told me to get Chinese visa first. At the moment, I was at Seoul, going back to Singapore. How am I supposed to apply a visa there. Plus the flight will be depart only at 3 hours later. Apparently, next into my counter, there's also a group of people having the same problem as me. They're also Indonesian who booked the the same flight and transit in xiamen. We all got rejected. And the most upsetting was, the staff attitude was incredibly rude and using a harsh word. We asked for a statement letter that we are rejected by the airlines staff for check in due to visa matter, and they did not provide anything but a harsh statement, saying that it was our problem, not them. And finally, arrogantly they close the counter and leaves us abandoned at the airport. That's my terrible experience with xiamen airlines. Hopefully this won't be happen to anyone else, and please do make a bisa if you still want to use this airline. And the fact that the visa fee is not that cheap, so the flight ticket also won't consider cheap as well. Better pick a different airlines with a better service. This airline is definitely not worth your time at all. And as my return flight, I ended up bought Asiana ticket with direct flight. Its a great experience tho. Will create another review for my Asiana experience.

When you arrive to the airport they will be one of few airlines not present. Literally, the worst airlines at least in china. If everything is OK, there is no problem. But when there is a problem you are in a deep sh*it

reviews.text: I booked TWO return tickets from Sydney to Hefei, with a layover in Xiamen. Unfortunately, I missed the second leg of my domestic flight (1.5 hours) to Hefei from Xiamen. Without ANY email notifications or warnings, they cancelled BOTH of my returning tickets to Australia! I have never experienced this with any other airline, especially when I intended to take the exact route back. After calling customer service, they noted my case, intending to call back. I called back myself as they never returned my call. They have terrible customer service, as well as being inconsistent in what they told us. I will not be flying through them again. First and last time. Also, the on-line check in procedure from Australia was a nightmare, they really need to update their user interface. The food is below average and in-flight entertainment lacking.

reviews.author: Tandem4Life

reviews.title: This airline is horrible.
reviews.text: What a mess. From beginning to end this airline was a series of disappointments and inconveniences. First came the 5AM stop in Quingdao where the entire plane had to clear immigration. I wasn't even aware of a stop on this route until I arrived at LAX to check-in. There we all were at a series of passport scanning kiosks at 5AM. 5 out of 15 weren't even working. Bleary eyed and about half of us wondering what the hell we were doing in Quingdao. Then for some inexplicable reason we had to clear security again even though we hadn't left the secure area of the airport. The stop was scheduled for 2 hours. I got back on the aircraft about 5 minutes before the doors closed to a completely full plane with no overhead space left. LAX to Quingdao was about 1/2 full. We picked up about 100 more local passengers for the continuing flight to Xiamen. I think we all know how considerate Chinese people are when it comes to leaving or making space for others in the overhead bins. Arrival in Xiamen and trying to find the transit desk to get my hotel for the 12 hour wait for my connecting flight was just a continuation of the nightmare. Nothing is clearly marked and it's as though the make it as inconvenient as possible to claim this benefit. After finally finding the correct spot I was advised that economy passengers must share a room with a stranger if you're traveling as a single person. You have the option to pay additional money for a single room, but that fee is actually more than the price the hotel charges per night if you reserve it on Agoda as a single. You also have to pay for the cab to the hotel, which is about 7 bucks. The food served on the LAX to Xiamen flight was mostly inedible. This airline was so bad that I actually didn't even use my return ticket from Bali to LAX. I purchased a Qantas return via Darwin and Brisbane. It was like business class compared to Xiamen Air. This carrier should have their One World affiliation revoked.
reviews.author: Seaside48647899905

reviews.title: FROM NOW ON THIS IS MY "GO TO" AIRLINE TO ASIA
reviews.text: Xiamen Air did not disappoint! The airplane was a new B787 Dreamliner with all the latest amenities like ambient lighting. Check-in and boarding process went smoothly. Ground staff and cabin crew are unusually customer oriented. Lavatories were refreshed several times each hour. The meals were satisfactory for airplane food. I pre-ordered "seafood" meals, which were tasty and worked out really well. I have traveled with almost all of the trans-pacific Asian airlines and Xiamen Air is my favorite!

The most unfriendly people I’ve ever come across. I almost cried when we came back to the us because it was that bad.
reviews.author: EyeNeedAVaca

reviews.title: Nothing major to complain about it.
reviews.text: The pros: - you probably got a sweet deal compared to other airlines -while you got a sweet deal, you didn’t get a budget airline like Sichuan which is awful. Our flight attendants knew basic English. - they had vegetarian meals on the plane. You just need to ask. They do run out though. - they give the transit hotel for free in Xiamen - no hassle or trouble checking in - coconut water on the plane. I love that stuff. The cons - while it is a Dreamliner, the seats are hard as a rock. My backside was sore for a while. - the selection of English TV shows is low and there’s only a handful of movies. - they don’t have a lot of flights so there seemed to be a lot of passengers with some dreadful layovers.
reviews.author: timgiang

reviews.title: Good flight
reviews.text: We flew Xiamen Airlines for a trip to Bali. Found them to be on time and service was very good. Newer plane and had good inflight entertainment. Only problem we had and minor at that was the food. Airline food in general isn't great and this want bad but not being Chinese it was unusual. Don't get me wrong we ate most of it easy enough but if your a picky eater be aware. Chinese airlines seem to be courting tourism, this is the second Chinese airline we've flown with and both had a 15 hour layover. They offer a free hotel or lounge access or a ticket for a hop on hope off city tour. We stayed a couple days in Xiamen on the way up, city was pretty cool. It was a pleasant surprise that we were glad we tried. I wouldn't hesitate to fly with them again.
reviews.author: Marc W

reviews.title: Horrible,Horrible
reviews.text: If I could give them 0,I would. Absolutely terrible experience and plan to never fly with this airline again. I guess the saying is true, you receive what you pay for. We had a layover in Xiamen for twenty hours and nobody cared to accommodate us. Secondly, after the twenty hours layover, there was a delay, which is fine because it’s inevitable. However, the rude staff around the airport did not accommodate nor helped when we asked questions. My friend who had an injury did not get a wheelchair assistance after we asked several times. Instead, they insisted that I push her. Is that even my job? Furthermore, don’t expect anyone who speaks English. They speak Chinese/mandarin as if you understand. Now,I’m not expecting English to be the primary language, at least do your best to accommodate your passengers.
reviews.author: Emma J

reviews.title: Alan M
reviews.text: I was leaving back to Los Angeles from Tokyo and I had a connecting flight that would leave from Xiamen, but they denied me boarding. They never gave me a clear answer to as why I couldn’t get onto the flight. First it was not having a visa (which the layover was only a couple of hours) then it was because my ticket was invalid. They did not want me on this flight, thus leaving me to figure it out on my own a day before thanksgiving. The ladies at the Xiamen counter in NRT Showed no empathy, nor did they ever communicate clearly with me to as why I couldn’t get on the plane.
reviews.author: Alan M

reviews.title: Direct flight from LAX to Qingdao, China
reviews.text: Nonstop flight. Excellent service. Newer Boeing jet. Business class has herringbone lay flat seats. Superb cabin service by very attentive and friendly attendants. Food is excellent. A new set of silverware for each course of the meal.
reviews.author: Eigerhike

reviews.title: Improving Airline
reviews.text: Improving a lot compare to a year ago especially handling of customer feedback and on/off line support. Should be able to improve on inflight meals, drinks, entertainment system.
reviews.author: Albert_Teo77

reviews.title: Unbelievable service. Best I've ever had
reviews.text: You'd think that flying 12 hours in economy class from Los Angeles to Bangkok with a 3 hour layover in Xiamen China would not be a great experience, but I have to admit that I've never had a better flight or service and experience than I did on the two flights to and from Bangkok. The flight attendants were wonderful. They made that 12 hour flight seem much shorter. They met my every need, and were nothing short of amazing. It was such a good experience that i plan on flying with Xiamen airlines from now on on all of my trips to Thailand.
reviews.author: Michael M

reviews.title: Great Flight!!
reviews.text: I was really worried that I screwed up our vacation by booking a cheap business class ticket from Lax to Sydney but, by the grace of God ,everything turned out great. They fed us very well on the trip,which US airlines could learn from and they were very friendly ,another thing US airlines could learn from. Seats were comfortable and we slept very well on the flight. We had a 9 hour layover in Qingdoa which I feared we would be very bored however we got a room at the Holiday Inn Parkview which is a short ride from the airport. We showered and left our luggage in the room and went downstairs to a huge buffet then walked to the Spirit of Olympics park however it is so big we were not able to see it all we had to go back to the airport for the next leg of the flight so it is not a bad thing having a long layover in China it is actually a good thing because you get a extra side vacation on the way to your real vacation. The entertainment was ok but if your really picky then I would down load my own entertainment state side before the trip.They had universal power port in business class,I am not sure about coach but I was able to charge my computer and phone. We had a round trip flight and service was consistently good on both legs of our flight. Would definitely fly them again and we are already planning another trip.
reviews.author: KARLANETTETX
